usage.title: Usage
usage.notMounted: No running pod mounts this claim, so nothing measures its usage.
usage.fromKubelet: Measured by the kubelets, refreshed every minute.
usage.kubeletForbidden: You may not read the kubelets' stats (nodes/proxy), so Prometheus is used.
usage.nodesFailed_one: {{count}} node did not answer: the claims mounted there are missing.
usage.nodesFailed_other: {{count}} nodes did not answer: the claims mounted there are missing.
usage.truncated: The cluster is too large: only part of the claims is measured.

thresholds.title: Volume usage
thresholds.warn: Almost full from this percent used
thresholds.critical: Critically full from this percent used
thresholds.hint: Space and inodes of a PersistentVolumeClaim count the same. Used by the Usage colours and by the problems category “Disk almost full”, which is off until you turn it on.

form.name: Name
form.invalidName: Use lowercase letters, digits, dashes and dots, up to 253 characters.

snapshot.classHint: The class decides which CSI driver takes the snapshot and what happens to it when it is deleted.
snapshot.restoreHint: Ready: it can be restored to a new PVC.

explain.unbound: No VolumeSnapshotContent is bound yet: check that the snapshot controller runs and that the class exists.
explain.pending: The CSI driver is still taking the snapshot.

restore.title: Restore {{name}} to a new PVC
restore.namespaceHint: A snapshot can be restored only into its own namespace.
restore.sizeHint: At least {{size}}, the snapshot's restore size.
restore.sizeTooSmall: Enter a size of at least {{size}}, such as 10Gi.

velero.backupNote: Velero backs up every object of {{namespace}} and, where it is set up for that, its volumes. The backup runs in Velero, not in Sextant.
velero.invalidName: Use lowercase letters, digits, dashes and dots, up to 63 characters.
velero.noLocations: No BackupStorageLocation was found: Velero may not be set up.
velero.ttlHint: A duration such as 720h0m0s (30 days, Velero's default); Velero deletes the backup after it.
velero.invalidTtl: Enter a duration such as 720h or 72h30m.
velero.restoreNote: Velero skips most objects that already exist (some kinds, such as ServiceAccounts, are merged) and counts them as warnings of the restore.
velero.restoreNoteMapped: Objects are restored into the namespaces you named. Velero skips most objects that already exist (some kinds, such as ServiceAccounts, are merged) and counts them as warnings of the restore.
velero.restoreNotCompleted: The backup's phase is {{phase}}, not Completed: the restore may fail or bring back only part of it.
velero.allNamespaces: The backup covers every namespace; each is restored under its own name.
velero.mappingHint: Leave a field empty to restore into the same namespace.
velero.invalidNamespace: Enter a namespace name: lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

explain.validationNoReason: Velero refused it as not valid.
explain.failedNoReason: It failed; Velero gave no reason.
explain.backupErrors_one: {{count}} error: some objects or volumes were not backed up.
explain.backupErrors_other: {{count}} errors: some objects or volumes were not backed up.
explain.restoreErrors_one: {{count}} error: some objects were not restored.
explain.restoreErrors_other: {{count}} errors: some objects were not restored.
explain.backupLogs: The details are in the log: velero backup logs {{name}}
explain.restoreLogs: The details are in the log: velero restore logs {{name}}
explain.paused: Paused: no new backups are made.
explain.unavailable: Velero cannot reach this storage location: {{message}}
explain.unavailableNoMessage: Velero cannot reach this storage location: check its credentials and bucket.
